[[File:Fetid zombie icon.png|left]]
'''Fetid zombie''' is a [[Slayer monsters|Slayer creature]] released with the [[Unwelcome Guests]] quest located near [[Crypt (Wilderness)|Wilderness crypt]] in the [[Wilderness]] to the north and west of [[Fort Forinthry]]. This monster - like others in the Wilderness - will not lose its aggression to the player, even after 15 minutes. This makes the zombies ideal for AFK training.
